serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: How did you like karaoke with Shanice? 
Bot: It was really fun! I didn’t know what she meant at the beginning, but later it was really fun and I’m glad I tried listening to her!
You: Sorry that I didn’t explain it to you properly. I just didn’t know how.
Bot: Don’t worry! You didn’t do anything wrong. I already learned many things about people from you and I’m grateful for that.
You: Yeah, me too.
